title: Dynamics SL Migration Prerequisites for Business Central

facts.text: Customer has Business Central online tenant.
At least one user has SUPER permission set in target company.
Dynamics SL migration retains existing Business Central user permissions; users not automatically reassigned to Intelligent Cloud.
Install Intelligent Cloud Base, Dynamics SL Migration, Dynamics SL Migration US, and Dynamics SL Historical Data apps.
Supported for United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Australia markets only.
SQL Server 2016 SP1 or later with compatibility level 130 or higher.
Download SL database preparation scripts and run procedures to enable change tracking on application database.
